meta.name: linkedin-profile-optimizer
meta.description: Audit and rewrite a LinkedIn profile end-to-end for 2026: headline, About 7-step, Featured, banner, photo, Experience metrics, Skills, custom URL, recommendations. Triggers on "review my profile", "rewrite my headline", "fix my About", "optimize banner", "profile audit", "LinkedIn bio". Converts resume-style profiles to ones that convert 3-5x better. Not for writing feed content (use linkedin-post-writer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把简历式的 LinkedIn 主页改写成能吸引招聘方与客户的专业形象
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 LinkedIn 主页主动带来机会,而不是只堆一份履历。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite your resume-style LinkedIn page into one that attracts recruiters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your LinkedIn page reads like a resume and you want it to win offers.

howto.what: Claude 会按 2026 标准逐项审查你 LinkedIn 主页的九个部分(头像、横幅、标题、About、Featured、Experience、Skills、自定义 URL、推荐),再改写不合格的章节,产出九项评分卡、按影响力排序的修改清单、改写前后对照和预期提升数据。
howto.when: 当你贴上 LinkedIn 主页链接要求审计,或提到“review my profile”、“改写标题”、“修 About”等说法,或要让主页配合内容策略时触发。

say.text: 这是我的 LinkedIn 主页链接,帮我做一次完整审计
say.note: 会输出九项评分卡和优先修改清单

say.text: 我目标是找客户,帮我重写标题和 Featured 区
say.note: Featured 内容按“找客户”目标匹配

say.text: 我 About 开头那段钩子够不够抓人?
say.note: 检查前 265-275 字符的钩子

howto.what_en: Claude audits all nine sections of your LinkedIn profile — headline, About, Featured and more — and rewrites the weak ones, returning a scorecard, ranked fixes, before/after copy, and expected uplift.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste your LinkedIn profile URL for an audit, or ask to rewrite your headline, About, or Featured section.

say_en.text: Here's my LinkedIn profile link — run a full audit on it.
say_en.note: Returns a nine-section scorecard and ranked fixes.

say_en.text: My goal is getting clients — rewrite my headline and Featured section.
say_en.note: Featured picks are matched to the clients goal.

say_en.text: Is the hook in my About section strong enough?
say_en.note: Checks the first 265-275 characters before 'see more'.
